Title: ChatToolbar.razor - Dynamic Chat Toolbar
Summary: Blazor component that dynamically renders all registered IToolbarComponent instances for the current chat kernel. Supports Start/End alignment and automatically passes the Kernel parameter to child components.
Content:
## ChatToolbar.razor **Namespace**: `Cyrena.Components.Shared` **Assembly**: `Cyrena.Components.Runtime` **Base Class**: `KernelComponentBase` ### Purpose Dynamic toolbar component that renders all registered `IToolbarComponent` instances for the current chat kernel. Supports alignment (Start/End) and automatically injects the Kernel parameter into child components. ### Razor Structure ```razor @inherits KernelComponentBase @using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection @using Cyrena.Extensions @if (_tb.Any()) {
@foreach (var item in _tb.Where(x => x.Alignment == ToolbarAlignment.Start)) { @this.Render(item.Component, new() { { nameof(KernelComponentBase.Kernel), Kernel } }) }
@foreach (var item in _tb.Where(x => x.Alignment == ToolbarAlignment.End)) { @this.Render(item.Component, new() { { nameof(KernelComponentBase.Kernel), Kernel } }) }
} ``` ### Behavior 1. Queries all `IToolbarComponent` services from the kernel's service provider 2. Renders Start-aligned components first (left side) 3. Adds a flex spacer (`ms-auto`) to push End-aligned components to the right 4. Renders End-aligned components last (right side) 5. Passes the `Kernel` parameter to each rendered component ### Toolbar Alignment | Alignment | Position | Typical Usage | |-----------|----------|---------------| | `ToolbarAlignment.Start` | Left side | Primary actions, mode-specific tools | | `ToolbarAlignment.End` | Right side | Secondary actions, export, clear, settings | ### Dynamic Rendering Uses `ComponentBaseExtensions.Render()` to dynamically instantiate toolbar components: ```csharp @this.Render(item.Component, new() { { nameof(KernelComponentBase.Kernel), Kernel } }) ``` This ensures each toolbar component receives the current `Kernel` instance via its `KernelComponentBase.Kernel` parameter. ### Lifecycle **OnInitialized:** - Queries `IToolbarComponent` services from `Kernel.Services.GetServices()` ### Registered Components By default, `ComponentAssistantsPlugin` registers: - `ExportChat` at `ToolbarAlignment.End` - `ClearChat` at `ToolbarAlignment.End` Other extensions can register additional toolbar components via `CyrenaKernelBuilderExtensions.AddToolbarComponent()`. ### CSS Classes Used | Class | Purpose | |-------|---------| | `d-flex` | Flexbox layout | | `flex-row` | Horizontal layout | | `mt-1` | Margin top (small) | | `mb-2` | Margin bottom | | `px-4` | Horizontal padding | | `ms-auto` | Auto margin start (pushes to right) | ### Related - `IToolbarComponent` - Contract (Cyrena.Components.Core) - `ComponentBaseExtensions.Render()` - Dynamic rendering helper (Cyrena.Components.Core) - `KernelComponentBase` - Base class (Cyrena.Components.Core) - `ComponentAssistantsPlugin` - Plugin that registers default toolbar components - `Chat.razor` - Parent component that renders this toolbar
